name: agentic-habits

plugins.name: habits
plugins.description: Agentic habits in three tiers: stated rules placed where their trigger fires, gates that make the ones that must not fail deterministic, and a read-only judge that scores adherence from evidence. Ships a working Stop hook, 20 starter habits, and 12 named anti-habits.
